data.summary: Results-driven Fund Administration professional with extensive experience in investment banking operations. Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and adapting to dynamic financial markets. Proven expertise in fund management, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and regulatory adherence. Adept at optimizing operational efficiency and delivering exceptional client service. Proficient in financial reporting, risk management, and client relationship management. Committed to leveraging strong analytical skills and detail orientation to support a growth-focused investment banking team and drive successful fund administration outcomes.

certifications.name:
Imarticus Learning (2021) Certified investment banking operations professional - Securities and derivatives End to End life cycle of Listed and OTC products AML/KYC Asset management Risk Management
Validate daily NAVs for portfolios, ensuring values remain within tolerance limits; investigate and provide detailed backup for any discrepancies to clients
Process monthly client fund requests on a specific schedule, managing the entire workflow from trade execution to final delivery without interruptions
Research and resolve all open holdings and cash discrepancies; communicate findings promptly to the onshore team for review
Troubleshoot team queries effectively, facilitating timely completion and delivery of reconciliations within deadlines
Manage client deliverables on daily, monthly, and quarterly timelines with accuracy and efficiency
Perform daily reconciliation of cash, positions, and market values for mutual funds to maintain data integrity
Coordinate between JV trade, cash, pricing, asset reconciliation, corporate action, and valuation teams to clear NAVs and client deliverables before cutoff times
Implement strategies to mitigate NAV impacts by minimizing discrepancies between prior and current day figures; conduct daily General Ledger break research
Handle fund fee accruals and expense ratio calculations, ensuring accurate asset-based fee preparation and prompt invoice payment
Performed Management Fee and Performance Fee calculations, including fee accruals, expense allocations, and invoice validation for investment funds.
Used Bloomberg/Reuters to validate security prices, corporate actions, and market data supporting NAV production and fund accounting.
Supported SWIFT-based cash and securities settlements, investigating failed transactions and coordinating with internal teams and custodians for timely resolution.
Process and review client invoices regularly; implement updated budget rates for expenses based on client requests and manage new accruals efficiently
Executed administrative support including daily accounts, attendance tracking, and payroll management to streamline office operations.
Coordinated bank loan arrangements for customers, enhancing client service and satisfaction.
Managed document control, scheduling, and invoicing to ensure timely project deliverables.
Ensured compliance with safety regulations, promoting a secure work environment.
Facilitated effective communication across teams to uphold company policies and operational efficiency.
Led the reverse migration of fund performance analytics from the Poland team to internal stakeholders at State Street Bank.
Developed and implemented a comprehensive training program, facilitating cross-training initiatives for team members.
Streamlined the fund administration process by effectively managing task transitions and ensuring knowledge transfer.
Enhanced operational efficiency through thorough oversight of the migration process, resulting in improved team performance and service delivery.
B.Tech/B.E. | Mechanical
Sri Sairam Engineering College, Chennai Grade - 6.8/10
2019
AchievementsAchievements
Achieved a second-level promotion within one year.
Received the "Star of the Month" award twice for outstanding work performance.
Received seven Bravo nominations within a brief time frame.
